ns2:section.sectionText: Education and Development: A Case Study in Ecuador. This course explores the intersection of education and development and the role of NGOs in supplementing state-based education in Ecuador. The group serves their host community by offering an educational enrichment camp for the local children. For more information, see: https://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/index.cfm?FuseAction=Programs.ViewProgram&Program_ID=10825&Type=O&sType=O On-campus meetings will begin the week of Feb. 20, 2012. Off-campus in Ecuador: July 7-August 4, 2012.
